University-partner courses

TEL Education partner-university courses

Current offer with eligibility limits. Official support directs adult learners to Briar Cliff; McMurry and Oklahoma Christian options require current high-school enrollment. Confirm partner eligibility and destination acceptance.

Research profile · confirm exact school and course acceptance

How the credit works

TEL supplies course delivery; the selected partner university grants and transcripts the academic credit. Preserve both identities.

Pace and learning format

Self-paced with minimum participation periods: one course requires 14 days, two 28, three 42 and four 56; maximum course window is six months.

Costs to check

Per-credit tuition. Official enrollment and support pages disagree ($100 versus $75 per credit); obtain the current partner checkout quote.

Check the current checkout terms and the costs that apply to your actual course list. Membership time, assessments, materials, retakes, transcripts, and school fees may need separate attention.

Assessments and requirements

Assignments and Honorlock-proctored exams; follow the chosen university and course rules.

Before you commit

  • Choose the exact receiving school, degree, and catalog year.
  • Confirm this specific course, recommendation or transcript source—not only the provider’s name.
  • Ask which requirement the learning will satisfy and check duplicate-credit, grade, date, and source limits.
  • Keep a written school decision before paying for an outside course you need for graduation.
